text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ah! I don't mean it in a bad way, okay? It's just, my whole body feels all fired up!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"...I can see it so clearly.
The hero crossing the finish line in first place,
striking a pose amidst the roaring cheers."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: "Watch me, Trainer! Watch my run bring dreams and hope to everyone!"
